title: MCP Server Design Plan
description: A structured plan for a Model Context Protocol server — transport, startup, logging, safety guards, tool-surface hygiene — so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/mcp_server_design_audit.mjs.

transport.description: The MCP transport. This skill covers stdio; http has different framing concerns.

startupStrategy.description: Whether heavy resources (indexes, models) load behind the first tool call (lazy) or at boot (eager). Must be lazy.

startupBudgetMs.description: Measured or budgeted time from process start to connect(). Quality Gates require < 100ms.

logsToStdout.description: True if any logging writes to stdout after connect(). Must be false on stdio — stdout is reserved for JSON-RPC frames.

exposesFileTools.description: True if any tool reads a file by caller-supplied path.

pathTraversalGuard.description: True if file tools resolve + startsWith-check paths against the root. Required whenever exposesFileTools is true.

errorsReturnIsError.description: True if handlers return { content, isError: true } instead of throwing.

errorsSanitized.description: True if errors are sanitized at the tool boundary — generic message to the client, detail to stderr, secrets never included.

requiresSecrets.description: True if the server needs API keys or other env-var secrets.

requiredEnvValidatedAtStartup.description: True if required env vars are validated at boot with an actionable error, not on the first tool call.

telemetryBlocking.description: True if any telemetry call blocks a tool response. Must be false — fire-and-forget with a short abort.

maxOptionalArgsPerTool.description: The largest number of optional arguments on any single tool. More than ~8 signals a tool doing too much.

descriptionsIncludeWhenNotToUse.description: True if every tool description includes capability, return shape, and a when-NOT-to-use clause.

inputsValidatedWithConstraints.description: True if tool inputs are validated by zod with min/max/enum constraints that surface as client metadata.

handshakeTestInCi.description: True if the initialize → tools/list handshake test runs in CI on every commit.
